line: Three districts of Shenzhen as flat posters that open into streets, fold like doors and screens, and stand up as walls until the city closes into a U.
line_cn: 深圳三个区像三张平面海报：拉开变成街道，楼像门扇和屏风一样折起来，整块地立成墙，最后把城市折成一个 U。
uses: City and district promos
Campus, park or property walk-throughs
Openers for travel and place-based series

line: A hand-coloured atlas plate unrolls westward: the states take their colours year by year, a covered wagon leads the way to the Pacific, and in 1869 the railway overtakes it.
line_cn: 一张手工设色的地图集图版向西展开：各州一年年上色，一辆篷车带路走到太平洋，1869 年铁路追上了它。
uses: How a country, a network or a market grew, year by year
Journeys along a real route with a guide to follow
History lessons and anniversary films

line: A handscroll unrolls along the real coast of Shenzhen: ink traces the shore, blue-green mountains stand up, cinnabar roads spread from Luohu and the towers of Futian rise as tiered pavilions.
line_cn: 一幅长卷沿着真实的深圳海岸展开：墨线勾出岸，青绿的山一座座立起来，朱砂的路从罗湖烧开，福田的高楼长成一层层的楼阁。
uses: City, district and coastline portraits
Routes and journeys: a road, a river, a metro line
Before-and-after stories of a place

line: A printed octilinear map of Guangzhou's real metro is dragged out line by line from five stations under the Pearl River in 1997, trains running on every finished line, until Line 11 closes the ring and the counter lands on 19 lines and 779.9 km.
line_cn: 一张印出来的八方向广州地铁图：从 1997 年白鹅潭江底的 5 个站开始，一条条线被拖出来，开通的线上一直有车在跑；11 号线把环合上，计数器落在 19 条线、779.9 公里。
uses: A metro or rail network's growth, year by year
One new line, a ring or an extension, drawn stop by stop
A network shown alive: lines, interchanges and trains on one printed map

line: A fictional high-speed rail station cut open on a thin plinth: the roof lifts away, and one passenger with a suitcase is followed in seven numbered steps, from the taxi through ID and security checks, the waiting hall, the ticket gates and the overpass to the train, while the other side walks out through the underpass; then the roof closes and the lights come on.
line_cn: 一座虚构的高铁站切开放在薄底座上：屋顶抬走，跟着一位拖箱子的旅客分七步讲，从下出租车、实名验证和安检、候车、检票、过天桥到上车，另一侧下车的人走地道出站；讲完屋顶合上，天黑亮灯。
uses: How a building or a hub works, one step at a time
A visitor's route through a hospital, airport, museum or factory
A place shown as a cut-away model, with its life in loops

line: The bridge and last chorus of hoy neo's song 风吹新竹, drawn frame by frame: two friends in two cities, a suitcase packed with home, a gust of wind on the chorus, a night street of lighting windows, and the word 家 (home) slammed down in the last lit one.
line_cn: hoy neo《风吹新竹》的桥段和最后一遍副歌，一格一格画出来：两个朋友在两座城市，行李箱里装进家乡，副歌一阵风吹过，夜街的窗一扇扇亮起，最后一扇亮着的窗里砸下一个「家」字。
uses: A lyric video for your own song, whole or a chorus: every line typed onto something in the picture
A poem, slogan or narration written onto the places and things it names
A city, campus or brand story told in collage type and flat cel drawings

line: A launch film for 建造观察局 (BITBUILD), the library author's own site, made from its real pages frozen as they are: company cards scattered in depth gather into one library, a revenue split is pushed in on and counted up, a line in an earnings article is underlined in place, two sources are bracketed into one feed, and the window folds into the brand's blue square.
line_cn: 给建造观察局（库作者本人的网站）做的发布片，画面是冻结下来的真实页面：散在纵深里的公司卡片汇进一页公司库，推近一个收入数字从 0 数上去，在财报文章原文里划出一句，两个来源被一道括线收到一处，最后整个窗口收成品牌的蓝色方块。
uses: A 30-second launch or promo film for a website or web app, from its URL or screenshots
A feature release: one claim per shot, each proved by a real component lifted out of the page
A product's year in numbers: real figures pushed in on, counted up and underlined where the page states them

line: A Demo trailer for the indie RPG 归路：新旅途, made with its developer's permission from the game's own footage and art: real gameplay fills the frame, captions sit on plates cut from the game's copper-and-iron UI, the camera pushes in until a trade counter reads 4351 → 14775 on the beat of the game's own score, and the crew wipes in before the logo lands with where to play it.
line_cn: 给独立游戏《归路：新旅途》做的宣传片，经开发者授权，用游戏自己的实机录像和美术：实机画面铺满全画面，字幕牌用游戏铜框铁板的 UI 材质，镜头卡着游戏原声的拍子推近交易所，货钞从 4351 跳到 14775，最后六位伙伴按拍擦入，Logo 落地，告诉你去哪儿玩。
uses: A 30–45-second trailer or Demo announcement for your own game, from its gameplay recording, key art and store page
A feature spot for one system (trading, combat, exploration): one real number or one real payoff carried through the film
A store-page or social-media cut for an indie, pixel, mobile or anime RPG, captioned in the game's own UI material

line: NEO-Isle's second isle, Snowfall Peak, filmed by a slow long lens: from a glass cube in deep space through the glass to yaks crossing the snow, an afternoon running into dusk over a stone hut as its window lights, a wait on the frozen lake until glowing fish swim up under the ice and the score drops, and back out to the whole container at night.
line_cn: 用一台很慢的长焦拍 NEO-Isle 的第二境《雪落寒山》：从深空里的玻璃立方体推进去，穿过玻璃，牦牛走过雪原；石屋前一个下午快进到黄昏，窗亮起来；镜头停在冰湖上等，冰面下发光的鱼游出来，配乐在这一刻落下；最后拉远，夜里的整只容器。
uses: A short film of an isle you made with NEO-Isle: through the glass, a day in seconds, the wonder, the whole
A 10-second loop or teaser of a miniature world for a post or a gallery card
A series trailer: several isles, or one isle in several containers, joined by a change of glass

line: Two AI characters sing their working day as a duet: Klaude thinks, Kodex runs, the tests go red, the frame freezes for half a second of silence, then twelve checks turn green and they hand over the cut. An unofficial fan film, vertical, one interface gag per lyric line.
line_cn: 两个 AI 角色把一天的活唱成二重唱：小克（Claude 娘）想得多，扣扣（Codex 娘）跑得快，测试红了一片，画面冻住半秒、一片安静，然后十二个全变绿，一起交出样片。非官方同人，竖屏，一句歌词一个界面梗。
uses: A song for an AI product, a mascot or a team: two characters act out the work, one interface gag per lyric line
A release note, weekly report or onboarding guide sung as a duet
A vertical fan MV for your own song, with characters drawn by an image model
